diagram_candidates.excerpt: The six distinct weights w·λ are indexed by W=S₃ ... Thus the directed Hasse diagram runs ...; all eight Bruhat covers are enumerated in steps 2.1–2.2, and step 3.1 identifies all embeddings.
diagram_candidates.kind: directed Hasse diagram of the A₂ Bruhat order / Verma embeddings
diagram_candidates.rationale: The body already specifies six vertices, their rank layers, the Bruhat comparabilities, and the eight cover embeddings. A diagram would make the embedding direction and the two intermediate rank-two vertices easier to compare.
diagram_candidates.labels_and_relations: Use vertices e, s₁, s₂, s₁s₂, s₂s₁, w₀, grouped by lengths 0,1,2,3. Bruhat-upward covers: e<s₁,e<s₂; s₁<s₁s₂,s₁<s₂s₁; s₂<s₁s₂,s₂<s₂s₁; s₁s₂<w₀,s₂s₁<w₀. Annotate arrows for the corresponding inclusions M(w·λ)→M(v·λ) when v<w, so module-map arrows point opposite to increasing Bruhat order.
diagram_candidates.classification: editorial candidate; source-supported, not a rendering defect
diagram_candidates.uncertainty: Drawing direction and labels should be checked against the body before authoring.
